# Oocyte Cryopreservation — Authorization Guide

_Subtitle: CPT Codes · ICD-10 · Payer Requirements_
_Back link: /oocyte-freeze_

## CPT Codes

| CPT | Description | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 58970 | Follicle puncture for oocyte retrieval, any method | Egg retrieval |
| 89337 | Cryopreservation, mature oocyte(s) | Egg freezing |
| 89352 | Thawing of cryopreserved; oocyte(s) | Egg thaw |
| 89353 | Thawing of cryopreserved; embryo(s) | Embryo thaw |
| 89250 | Culture of oocyte(s)/embryo(s), less than 4 days | Lab — culture |
| 89254 | Oocyte identification from follicular fluid | Lab — oocyte ID |
| 89280 | Assisted oocyte fertilization, microtechnique; ≤10 oocytes (ICSI) | ICSI at thaw |
| 96372 | Therapeutic, prophylactic, or diagnostic injection | Trigger injection |

## ICD-10 Diagnoses

| ICD-10 | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Z31.62 | Encounter for fertility preservation procedure |
| E28.31 | Premature menopause |
| E28.39 | Other primary ovarian failure |
| C50.919 | Malignant neoplasm of unspecified site of unspecified female breast (oncofertility) |
| C56.9 | Malignant neoplasm of unspecified ovary |
| Z79.899 | Other long-term (current) drug therapy (chemotherapy) |
| Z31.83 | Encounter for assisted reproductive fertility procedure cycle |

## Coverage Landscape

### Common Denial Reasons

- Elective egg freezing: almost universally excluded
- "Experimental" (incorrect since ASRM removed experimental label in 2013)
- Storage fees (89337 annual storage) often excluded separately
- Oncofertility denied if oncology diagnosis not clearly linked

### Strongest Coverage Arguments

- Oncofertility: ASCO 2018 guideline — fertility preservation is standard of care before gonadotoxic therapy
- ASRM 2013: oocyte cryopreservation is no longer experimental
- POI/genetic condition: medical necessity for fertility preservation
- Some state mandates (IL, NY, CT, NJ) include fertility preservation for iatrogenic infertility

## Prior Authorization Requirements

### Required Documentation

- For oncofertility: oncology treatment plan documenting gonadotoxic therapy type and timeline
- Ovarian reserve testing (AMH, AFC, Day 3 FSH)
- Letter of medical necessity from REI specialist
- For POI/genetic: documentation of diagnosis
- ASCO fertility preservation referral note (if oncofertility)
